name: Tragniew Park Compton Crips
description: The Tragniew Park Compton Crips (TPCC) are a predominately African-American street gang located on the West Side of Compton, California. They originated in the mid-1970s after the Taper Street Pirus, a Blood gang active in the area during the early 1970s, transitioned into a Crips set.
